title: malus sylvestris var. bulgarica
intro: Malus sylvestris var. bulgarica, commonly known as Bulgarian wild apple, is a variety of wild apple tree native to Bulgaria. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits. The Bulgarian wild apple is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to have antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
